orthographic:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Production turnaround sheet for a low-poly racing game asset, three true orthographic views on one wide image: FRONT (left), SIDE (centre), TOP (right), exactly the same metre scale, front and side on a shared ground baseline. Flat neutral grey background, soft even studio lighting, no perspective, no ground shadow, no text except the small view labels and a 1 m scale bar. Complete asset in every view with enough spacing and no cropping.
ASSET: one monumental Tidal Pump Gantry, a repaired aerospace service portal. Overall span about 46 m and height 20 m; structure depth 8 m. Exactly TWO warm concrete feet at the far left and right; inner foot edges 38 m apart. Two tall metal support towers stand on these feet. Exactly THREE open overhead triangular lattice trusses run across the full span at front, middle and rear, all lower surfaces above 14 m. The whole centre below 14 m is entirely EMPTY, no hanging hooks, crossbars, dangling cables or machinery. One cylindrical pump drum is mounted OUTSIDE the RIGHT tower, its horizontal cylinder axis front-to-back, never inside the opening. One ladder climbs the OUTSIDE face of the LEFT tower. Exactly FOUR small caged sodium lamp heads under the truss edges, three restrained amber heads and one dark dead head. Exactly TWO obvious welded rectangular repair plates, one on each tower.
ROLE IN THE RACE: frames a safe recharge corridor. The generous empty opening must be recognizable from 150 m at racing speed. It is a service portal, not a finish-line gate; no checks, arrows or racing banners.
STORY WEAR: originally aerospace pump equipment, repaired for twenty humid years. Two welded patches, sun-bleached faded olive paint on top, oxidized steel edges, dark damp footings with chunky algae stains on shaded sides, sparse faded maintenance stencil blocks. Strong boundary between broad warm concrete feet and repaired steel.
STYLE: remembered early-2000s console racer, original design. Honest low-poly geometry with clear calm silhouette, hand-painted texture language readable at 256-512 px, painted ambient occlusion and damp staining. Restrained warm concrete, oxidised olive steel, sodium amber, swamp green. Small amber lamp accents only, no glow halos.
MATERIALS: only concrete, metal, jungle/algae, water, signage, emissive roles may appear; no water surface is required on this standalone prop.
AVOID: neon, vaporwave, luxury spacecraft, photoreal PBR, bloom, lens flare, busy chrome, tiny greebles, route obstructions, new details invented between views. Counts and proportions agree in every view.
